selection.metadata: Retain5 prior late failures without shortening; require50ms support inside active interval. Active edges are not MIDI gates.
selection.anchor: Same first-body entry+.15 for body+late. Never replace weak/null anchor.

extractor.basis: DC, lineartrend, sin/cos at fixed h*f0 for h1..10, each harmonic sin/cos also multiplied by centeredtime. Centercoefficients allow local affine complex amplitude; no frequency fit.
extractor.floor: Quadrature coefficient error scale from weighted linear projection: sqrt(sum(Bcos²+Bsin²)/12)/32768. Use max with fixed quiet harmonic magnitude. Deterministic PCM16 rounding is not established white/independent noise; recovery controls test this heuristic.
extractor.cell_requirements: VisibleH1, at leastone scoredharmonic visible at BOTHanchor/current, finitepeak<.98, weighted fitresidual<=.1
extractor.phase_invariant: arg(Zh(t)/Zh(anchor))−h*arg(Z1(t)/Z1(anchor)); compare full predicted Besselphasechange, not aconstant.

model.transfer_limit: Cancels fixed bin gain only under locally narrowband/constant-transfer approximation; not arbitrary changing-envelope LTI filtering.
model.phase_profile: 33canonicalδ in[0,pi/2]; retain both conjugate signs for phase. Magnitude identifies cos2δ only.
model.beta_grid: 2401logspaced .001..8 inclusive for anchor and per-epoch; no exponential or monotonicity prior
model.candidate_cells: All betaEpoch candidates with scored-harmonic dB RMS<=.1 and phaseRMS<=.2rad where phaseeligible. betaEpoch=betaAnchor at fixedanchor. Exclude absB1<=1e−8 only as declared numerical-domain conditioning.
model.profile_gate: Every observablecell has candidate; mean bestcell RMS<=.075dB, with denominator including the fixed zero-error anchor among observablecells. Precision requirements chosen before synthetic/source extraction, not data-derived. No rate prior or preferred branch.
model.branch_preservation: Retain all accepted βanchor/δ/sign profiles in compressed arrays; retain conservative latent/slope ranges across every accepted per-time β branch.
model.failed_cells: Invalidanchor fails note; invalidepochs retained. Interval needs all17 fixedepochs observable for a qualified slope.
model.slope_bound: OLS is a linear functional of per-epoch dB; conservative extrema across per-time accepted candidates and all nuisance branches. Finite-grid compatible ranges, not confidence intervals.
model.finite_domain: All ranges conditional on beta in[.001,8], canonicalphasegrid and zero-feedback PMfamily. Not global identifiability: disconnected aliases outside domain not ruled out. Any accepted anchor/per-time beta endpoint hit rejects a precision claim.

controls.signal: 2seconds44100Hz, knownnoteon.3. Internal t=max(time−.3,0)*(1+ppm*1e−6), theta=2pi*(f0*internal_t+phasecycles), A=A0*10^(−carrierRate*internal_t/20), beta=beta0*10^(−betaRate*internal_t/20). Full dynamic waveform, zero beforeon, then declared sample-domain processor and PCM16 nearest rounding without dither. Fractional delay0.3sample; causal ButterworthLP4/3k,HP2/30Hz; delayedcopy80ms weight.6; compressor rectifiedpeak detector attack10ms/release200ms threshold.25, gain=max(env/.25,1)^(−2/3).

Dryclockppm=constantoffset; Realclockppm=sinusoidaldriftamplitude at.1Hz withoffset0. Nativef0 fixed to printed17digit nominalfrequency (dry multiplied byknownconstantclockfactor), no frequencyfit. Nativecurrentrate truth=2*2^(D2R/4), dryclockscaled; Realnominaltruth with existing20ppm smallvariation inside fixed error bounds. NativefullFM/envelope/resampler/output path used; no factorydata required.

positive_gate.rule: All recovery-class controls: both fixed17epoch intervals must be observable, no accepted betaendpoint hit, truth within conditionalbounds expanded by stated error, width within fixedlimit. Also report UNEXPANDED truthcoverage independently so a narrowbiased result is visible. A and beta qualifications separate; ANY recovery/finitegrid/null-information failure stops before new real-source inference. Never relaxvisibility or shiftwindows forfastfloorcontrols.

controls.null_information: Constantbeta must retain anchorbeta range spanning at leastfactor4 on coarse/denser grids, not falsely identifyabsolute beta. Pure-sine/no-beta and exactH1-null controls must not produce acceptedunique beta profiles; failure ofobservability is retained.
controls.confounds: Keep delayedpath/compressor/chorus/two-tone outcomes including falseaccepts. Dynamicgain equivalence proves physicalhardwareA not identifiable from capture alone.
